# Medison Co., LTD

> > Medison Co., LTD is a Guilin-based manufacturer specializing in organic essential oils (particularly sea buckthorn products) and FDA 510K-certified medical devices.

The company holds multiple certifications including CERES organic, ISO9001, ISO22000, and cGMP standards. Medison serves international clients including L'Occitane and focuses on CO2 extraction methods for premium essential oils rich in omega-7, beta-carotene, and vitamin E.

## Key Topics

- Sea Buckthorn Seed Oil
- Sea Buckthorn Berry Oil
- Sea Buckthorn Flavones
- Essential Oils
- Medical Devices
- FDA 510K Certification
- CERES Organic Certification
- ISO9001 & ISO22000
- CO2 Extraction
- Omega-7 Fatty Acids
- Beta-Carotene
- Vitamin E
- Nitrile Gloves
- Cosmetic Ingredients
- cGMP Manufacturing
